story.title: Our Story
story.body: Founded in 1989 in Amman, Yasmine Plastics began as a small local manufacturer serving the Jordanian food-service industry. Over three decades we grew into one of the region's most trusted suppliers of plastic packaging, serving clients across retail, hospitality, catering, and industrial sectors. Today we operate a modern production facility and ship to clients throughout Jordan and the wider Levant region.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To deliver high-quality, durable, and customisable plastic packaging solutions that meet the real-world needs of our clients — on time, at the right price, with the flexibility to adapt. We measure success by our clients' satisfaction and the long-term relationships we build together.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be the leading plastic packaging manufacturer in the Levant region, known for innovation, sustainability, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction. We aim to continuously invest in technology and talent to deliver products that set the benchmark for quality.

values.title: Our Values
values.body: Quality, reliability, transparency, and partnership define everything we do. We treat every client relationship as a long-term collaboration, not a transaction. We hold ourselves accountable to the highest standards — in our materials, our processes, and our service.
